_about: Dry run cases for tools/brand_check_dryrun.py (issue #137). Each route says where its recorded response comes from: 'capture' is a real response body captured live by the coordinator on issue #51 (file and hash in ../brandcheck/provenance.json); 'status_record' is a real status from the coordinator's status table on issue #51 (../brandcheck/status-captures.json), for legs judged on status alone; 'synthetic' is a SYNTHETIC response written for this harness, labelled inside its body file or in its 'synthetic' note here. No route is ever fetched live.

cases.name: Nike
cases.about: Real captures only. Platforms limited to X: Instagram and TikTok answer every name with a 200 login wall, so they can never read taken (see the mixed case).

cases.name: zqxflorp
cases.about: Real captures only: RDAP 404 and X 404 from the status table, and the real iTunes search that returned two unrelated apps.
